title: Refactor Booking Cutoff Logic into a Shared Policy Module
summary: Extract the booking edit/cancel cutoff enforcement logic from `server/src/routes/bookings.ts` into a dedicated policy module `server/src/policies/bookingPolicy.ts`. This improves testability and ensures the cutoff rules have a single authoritative location.
requirements: Create `server/src/policies/bookingPolicy.ts` that exports: - `checkCutoff(booking, voyage): { allowed: boolean, reason?: string }` - `LIFECYCLE: string[]` (the ordered status array, moved from bookings.ts) - `getStatusIndex(status: string): number`
The `checkCutoff` function must contain the identical logic currently inline in `server/src/routes/bookings.ts`
Remove the inline `checkCutoff` definition and `LIFECYCLE` array from `bookings.ts` and import them from the new policy module instead
All existing test behaviour of the PUT and POST /cancel endpoints must remain identical
The refactor must not change any API response shapes or status codes
acceptanceCriteria: All existing endpoints that use `checkCutoff` or `LIFECYCLE` continue to function identically
`server/src/policies/bookingPolicy.ts` is the single source of truth for cutoff logic
references: server/src/routes/bookings.ts (source of checkCutoff and LIFECYCLE to be extracted)
